introHtml: Gray tissues and wipes offer a neutral, professional look that blends seamlessly into corporate offices, healthcare facilities, and event spaces. Unlike bright or patterned options, gray complements any decor while keeping the focus on your brand logo or message. These are ideal for safety managers stocking break rooms or marketing directors preparing giveaway kits for trade shows. Custom imprinting with your company name or slogan is available on both tissue packs and wipe canisters.
